answer: The saffron index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1713 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the cedar. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the atlas queue while honest participants promoted earlier keep earning. Bonded capital sits idle for 8 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
